## Overview

ThermoSense is an annual SPIE conference series focused on thermal infrared applications and thermography. The 2026 edition, Thermosense XLVIII, takes place on 27 April 2026 at National Harbor, Maryland, within SPIE Defense + Commercial Sensing (26–30 April 2026). The SPIE conference page serves as the primary reference point for the programme, call for papers, and proceedings links.
